footer.tagline: Bringing Italy's mountain villages online — discover, explore and help them thrive.

home.heroIntro: Empowering mountain villages through digital visibility and sustainable travel. Explore authentic Italian villages, access clear and updated information, and travel beyond the usual routes — while helping local communities thrive.
home.aboutLead: A single home for Italy's mountain heritage.
home.aboutBody: Mountain-Able is a shared platform where small Italian municipalities publish and keep up to date the tourism information of their villages — attractions, events, traditions and practical details — and where travellers discover places that rarely appear on the usual maps. By centralising trustworthy information and community reviews, we help underrepresented villages gain visibility while giving visitors a richer, more responsible way to explore.
home.aboutBody2: Every visit to a mountain village supports local families, artisans and traditions. We surface the events, food and crafts that keep these communities alive, so your journey directly benefits the places you discover — not just the crowded destinations everyone already knows.

faq.a1: Mountain-Able is a digital platform that gathers tourism information about small Italian mountain villages in one place. Municipalities publish and maintain their village pages, and travellers can search, discover and review these often-overlooked destinations.
faq.a2: Villages are managed by municipality officers — official representatives of each comune. Officers request an account, an administrator approves it, and they can then create and update the villages belonging to their municipality. Tourists cannot create villages, only review them.
faq.a3: Yes. Browsing villages, reading and writing reviews, and creating a tourist account are completely free. The platform exists to promote mountain communities, not to sell bookings.
faq.a4: Every registered tourist can leave one review with a 1–5 star rating per village. A village's average score and review count are recalculated automatically from all approved reviews, so the rating always reflects genuine visitor feedback.
faq.q5: How do I report incorrect information?
faq.a5: Use the Support link in the footer to contact us, or report a specific review for moderation. Administrators review reported content and can correct or remove inaccurate information.

about.title: About Mountain-Able
about.lead: A digital bridge for Italy's mountain communities.
about.missionBody: Italy's mountain villages hold centuries of culture, craft and natural beauty, yet many struggle with depopulation and low visibility. Mountain-Able gives every small municipality a single, trustworthy place to tell its story, and gives travellers an easy way to find and support these communities.
about.whatWeDoBody: We centralise tourism information, make villages discoverable through search and maps, and let visitors share honest reviews. Municipality officers keep each page accurate, while administrators safeguard the quality of the content.
about.scopeBody: The platform focuses on discovery and information — not bookings, payments or transport. This keeps it a neutral, community-first showcase for mountain heritage.
